notes.content:
Today is my birthday!

And with that, a mid-sized update is in order~
The main focus of this update was quality-of-life improvements, for both sides. Since there are many visible and behind-the-scenes changes, I’ll highlight the most important categories:

Technical Backend

Optimization

Linux Support

Always available Manual

Labyrinth Paths Help

And many, many more hidden stuff.
Also made a small teaser, for some... purposes:[previewyoutube="BLRle58C1wQ;full"][/previewyoutube]

Changes:
New Dialogue/Monologue animated formatting.

(Nerf) Different Anxiety defence requirement. \[It's easier to understand now...?]

Rectified Disclaimer when it comes to bug awareness, recording requests and possible contact. 

Updated to Unity 6.

Launcher without Engine logo.
Fixes:
 Dialogue/Monologue text generation speed is now stable on all refresh rates.

Fixes:

 Two softlocks in RedRoom are no more!

Additions:

 New Scene, A.K.A Grass.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565588/542e5cbf8125941ddea335978bea3edebf5f1ec3.png
 Solid Rework of already existing scene, A.K.A RedRoom.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565588/19913514e246e189e978730c987c80edd5f8aef5.png
 Tutorial Intro.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565588/b3bdcc2bf0398b790a12d54cffa301d34578661b.png
 New Logo in Menu.
 Loading Icon.
 Contact and Credits now include their content of purpose.
 New Monologue [Currently 4 now].



Changes:

 Polish Text Font.
 Settings Design.


Fixes:

 Steam shortcut icons are now properly resizable.
 [ I have no clue anymore what else ]

Changes:

 New mockup and logo for the engine launch.
 Game File and Save pathing changed.

Fixes:

 Saving works properly again. [On top of that, Shared Cloud Storage is now enabled]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565588/d50eabe8731680edae104cd3185ee1452e7e81d7.jpg
Just a lot of Steam stuff like:

 Demo is a thing now.
 Other versions now have unique icons.
 Every version has a unique EXE file.
 Separate save paths. [For now?]
 And who knows what else-

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565588/eb2a071b233bdecd68cfae03c3e2fbeb8eaf1208.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565588/9fd4a4e01e5653a43f5e89b911473ed785582123.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565588/e98d49516306ec0d2af3848dde0d884c2fe27c1e.png

Changed:

 Changed Save Cloud path and .exe name in order to avoid special characters.

Fixes:

 The game is now half the storage size, cause previously Steam Depot placed an additional copy of the game build inside the game file itself. :/

[previewyoutube=jZ9JGN82fjA;full][/previewyoutube]
Additions:

 New Scene prototype [Gameplay]
 Chapters visuals in Menu
 Settings - Volume, 60 FPS Block, Reset Data, Reset Achievements.
 Catalyst SFX.
 New ToGame Catalyst

Changes:

 "My Child" achievement is back!
 Project launches with Unlimited FPS Cap.

Fixes:

 Fixed sensitivity in a scene [Slightly].
 [Turns out I have been misspelling "prepArations" in my builds for the past 3 weeks, haven't noticed, heh-]

Changes:

 The title now has a dot after "Mr" [Simply just a formal grammatical design change].
 Changed to a better-looking output animation in Catalyst [Loading Screen].

Fixes:

 When selecting Localization sequence, it now automatically selects a button for the currently active language.
 Eyes Coloring is now less repeatable.
 Menu Sprite's eyes now close during an attempt to close the game.
 Exit now doesn't activate "after the blink effects" just before the exit itself.

Fixes:

 The Polish Localization blockage for the intro is no more. [... I think]

Additions:

 The Launch Disclaimer Warning with a localization choice along with the first save launch.
 The synchronised blinking gimmick for Menu.
 The Title.
 All of the Menu options now have their sequences + animations. [Under Construction]
 The variety of Catalyst [Loading screen] animations.
 The new OST layer for Menu.

Changes:

 The sprite for Menu got changed.
 Changed Menu start requirement.
 Catalyst between scenes is now not a scene itself but a Universal Object, and with that, its behaviour has changed. [A lot has changed]
 Catalyst IS NOW ACTUALLY a loading screen.
 Changed the thickness of Texts.

Fixes:

 Text Reader is now more proficient.
 Text Eraser in intro doesn't show "
" anymore.
 Save File structure simplified.
 Scene Requirements for scene memory simplified.

And who knows what else, can't recall-

Content

 +2 Intro Monologues.

UI

 16:10 Compatibility.
 The Localization menu is now more suitable.
 Menu buttons' state animations sweetened.

System

 [With the first launch] Enhanced detection for lack of Save Data.
 [With the first launch] Steam API detection isn't leaky anymore.
 [With the first launch] Build Version string updates.

Gameplay

 Slight environmental changes. [Just lifted the ceiling a bit-]

- Localization Structure Upgrade [Dynamic, now doesn't require a scene restart].
 
- "Steam Launch" Achievement is no more.
- "My Child Achievement" is now unachievable; it's mine and mine only! [Except for Peter, he can have it, he's cool]
